love-peace.experiencer: Bruce
love-peace.title: The near death experience of Bruce Van Natta
love-peace.quote: But when I went up on the roof of the garage, I don't have words to describe how good it felt. It was perfect peace. It's like the probably the best way I can describe it. And even that is like way lame because that doesn't even cover it. But perfect peace is what I experienced.

love-peace.experiencer: Deborah
love-peace.title: The near death experience of Deborah King
love-peace.quote: I remember just taking that message in and feeling just so, so warmed and overwhelmed with that amount of love that I was witnessing and feeling. I can only describe it as unearthly love. It was nothing like any love I had experienced.

love-peace.experiencer: Doorway to Oneness - With Julien Chameroy (Podcast episode 3)
love-peace.title: Doorway to Oneness - With Julien Chameroy (Podcast episode 3)
love-peace.quote: And I felt something I never really felt like that before. I felt love from I never experienced before. love-peace.experiencer: The near death experience of Vinney Tolman (Podcast episode 2)
love-peace.title: The near death experience of Vinney Tolman (Podcast episode 2)
love-peace.quote: You know, our our experience over there is truly magical. It's mystical. It's full of love. It's full of it's full of a love that we're not allowed to even know about here. And that love is so powerful that we have to forget it for us to come here. Because if we could remember it, we would you know, we would do whatever we needed to do to get ourselves back there.

love-peace.experiencer: The near death experience of Vinney Tolman (Podcast episode 2)
love-peace.title: The near death experience of Vinney Tolman (Podcast episode 2)
love-peace.quote: But when you're on the other side and you're feeling that love, you know with every every bit of your being, you know for a fact that that love is for you. sent-back.title: Experiencing the Angels

sent-back.title: Experiencing Miracles - With Carlos Vivas
sent-back.quote: Okay Carlos go back and tell everyone what happened here.

sent-back.title: Straight to Heaven : A Message from the Angels
sent-back.quote: And then God saying to me, "Lorna, you have to go back. You have an awful lot to do. You're not to be hiding from me."

sent-back.quote: Lewis you were called here to have this conversation and to be sent back because you are not doing your work

sent-back.title: Who we are (Documentary)

sent-back.experiencer: Messages from the other side - With Pontea Dianati

sent-back.title: Renaissance (Documentary)
sent-back.quote: And then I was forced back. The next thing I remember, I woke up.

sent-back.experiencer: How Filmmaker Anthony Chene Explores Consciousness and the Fabric of Reality
sent-back.title: How Filmmaker Anthony Chene Explores Consciousness and the Fabric of Reality

sent-back.experiencer: The near death experience of Gabe Poirot
sent-back.title: The near death experience of Gabe Poirot
sent-back.quote: And so, he sent me back to my body and I was actually miraculously brought back to life.

sent-back.experiencer: The near death experience of Jonathan Ashford
sent-back.title: The near death experience of Jonathan Ashford

sent-back.experiencer: The near death experience of Malcolm Nair
sent-back.title: The near death experience of Malcolm Nair

sent-back.title: The near death experience of Pegi Robinson

sent-back.title: The near-death experience of Heidi Craig

sent-back.title: The near-death experience of Ingrid Honkala

sent-back.title: The near-death experiences of Bill McDonald

sent-back.experiencer: The near death experience of Rob Gentile
sent-back.title: The near death experience of Rob Gentile
sent-back.quote: He said to me, I've made a big mess out of things and you have to go back and help clean things up, but tell my family I'm in a good place.

sent-back.experiencer: The near death experience of Rob Gentile
sent-back.title: The near death experience of Rob Gentile
sent-back.quote: But I knew too that I was sent back for a reason. I had to help get my daughter and my wife safely to the other side.

sent-back.experiencer: The near-death experience of Chris Batts
sent-back.title: The near-death experience of Chris Batts

sent-back.experiencer: The near-death experience of Chris Batts
sent-back.title: The near-death experience of Chris Batts

sent-back.experiencer: The near-death experience of Tricia Barker

being-presence.title: The near-death experience of Chris Batts

realer-than-real.experiencer: The near death experience of David Ditchfield
realer-than-real.title: The near death experience of David Ditchfield
realer-than-real.quote: Yeah, a lot of people do ask me that question and basically my answer to it is that it's ultra real. It's another dimension, but it's as real as we are sitting here chatting to each other now. It's three dimensional as that. But everything’s so ultra real that it's stayed with me now, I’ve never forgotten any of it.

realer-than-real.experiencer: The near death experience of Karen Thomas
realer-than-real.title: The near death experience of Karen Thomas
realer-than-real.quote: The reality of it was so much more intense than what we all experience in everyday life.

realer-than-real.experiencer: The near death experience of Tammy Lee Anderson
realer-than-real.title: The near death experience of Tammy Lee Anderson
realer-than-real.quote: And the experience is more real than real. A dream or a hallucination is very discombobulated. It's disorganized. You might remember parts of it, but it can be very unsettling. This experience is more real than real. It's home, and I remember it like yesterday.

realer-than-real.experiencer: The near death experience of Nancy Rynes
realer-than-real.title: The near death experience of Nancy Rynes
realer-than-real.quote: it felt like i was there it was more real almost than here

realer-than-real.experiencer: The near death experience of Nancy Rynes
realer-than-real.title: The near death experience of Nancy Rynes
realer-than-real.quote: but it is it does feel more real than here and in fact it's still hard for me to be here because this doesn't feel this doesn't feel real this this feels like the dream that feels like being awake

realer-than-real.experiencer: Deborah
realer-than-real.title: The near death experience of Deborah King
realer-than-real.quote: I didn't at all feel like I had imagined where I was or hallucinated. It was very real to me in that moment. In fact, it was much realer than where I was.

oneness.experiencer: In search for a meaning - Interview with Fredric Mindful
oneness.title: In search for a meaning - Interview with Fredric Mindful
oneness.quote: What is really the difference between you and I? And if you really go down deep enough and you really, you really do this, stick with this practice, you'll realize that there is no difference. We're all part of the same thing. We're all in this dream together.

oneness.title: Discovering Spirit
oneness.quote: when you know oneness you don't need books to tell you because when we try to give an answer out of our heads we nearly always get it wrong but if you just look at the sky what happens you sort of just expand and melt into it don't you that's what happened you just melt into it just forget yourself and you just melt into that that freedom

oneness.title: The primacy of consciousness
oneness.quote: where people get into a different state of mind and suddenly they see that everything's really connected it isn't all separate pieces it's all one big unit you just realize that you're just one little piece of the whole and all of the pieces are connected and it's beautiful

oneness.title: Experiencing the Divine
oneness.quote: The essence of the experience is this direct knowing of oneness, of unity, of union, of communion.

oneness.title: A Journey to Oneness
oneness.quote: the sense of being a separate individual self was also swallowed up because of that recognition that it's all just one happening one energy one intelligence knowing itself

oneness.title: Experiencing Miracles - With Carlos Vivas
oneness.quote: You're gonna start walking with me and walking with them from today you're part of me I'm part of all of them.

oneness.title: Beyond Our Sight (Documentary)
oneness.quote: if you think of each of our consciousnesses as one little grain of sand and infinite intelligence as the old beach of sand I was plugged back in my little grain of sand was back on the beach where I belonged where I came from

oneness.title: Who we are (Documentary)
oneness.quote: In my journey I saw very clearly not just the afterlife, but I saw oneness with that Divine, becoming one with.

oneness.title: Enlightenment (Documentary)
oneness.quote: We sometimes get a feeling like there's something else going on here, that there's something much more connected, that in a very real sense we're sharing the same dream. I recognize that I'm in some ways playing a role, but who I really am is so much bigger, so much more mysterious. It's eternal, it's infinite, it's timeless, it's connected to everything. Then there's this collaboration, a symphony of all these different harmonious pieces, each of us playing a part of the overall song, and that this is the so-called music of the spheres, that it's our consciousness that creates all of this. And when we get there, then that is oneness because everything's back together again.

oneness.title: Remembering who we are
oneness.quote: But once in meditation or other spiritual practices, you come to experience our true nature of interconnectedness and you realize that the love we're looking for outside ourselves is really here. You understand that heaven really isn't a place. It is a state of being and it's right here. But it doesn't mean that once you have this realization your life is perfect and you walk around in a state of bliss all the time. Don't I wish. But once you've tasted it here in this physical body, you know it's part of you. It's always already here and it's accessible. And that's when you sense what true oneness is. It's a sense of inner connection. And by the way, when when something can't be separated, when there is no separation, that's my definition for love.

oneness.title: Renaissance (Documentary)
oneness.quote: The grass had a distinct loving music frequency coming from it. just to even be near it, you would feel connected to everything in heaven.

oneness.experiencer: How Filmmaker Anthony Chene Explores Consciousness and the Fabric of Reality
oneness.title: How Filmmaker Anthony Chene Explores Consciousness and the Fabric of Reality
oneness.quote: The oneness idea is not about being kind. It's not that. It's not like I want to be one with people around me and play nice. It's it's it's much deeper than that. It's the nature of reality and of consciousness itself. At some level, we are the whole scene. And that's enlightenment. We are not the small character in a scene. We are the whole scene.

oneness.title: The near-death experience of Jeff Olsen
oneness.quote: And that's what I was experiencing. I was them and they were me. And there was this oneness, this connection that was undeniable. And I was the heroin addict, I was the nurse. I was all of it. I was everything and everything was me.

oneness.title: The near-death experience of Jeff Olsen
oneness.quote: As I was wrapped in those arms, it was almost like me and my little boy became part of that, like we became God.

oneness.experiencer: The near death experience of Penny Wittbrodt
oneness.title: The near death experience of Penny Wittbrodt
oneness.quote: And when you're on the other side, you realize that we are connected to everyone. And And even if, you know, if somebody's getting murdered across town here, I don't know them, but that's injuring me in some way because we're all connected.

oneness.experiencer: The near death experience of Jonathan Ashford
oneness.title: The near death experience of Jonathan Ashford
oneness.quote: I also had a third party view where I was outside of myself and another person arguing. I was the pavement. I was the parking lot paint lines. I was the building. I was the car. I was the sky. I was the son and I could feel it all wsez based on two people spitting poison at each other.

oneness.experiencer: The near death experience of Jonathan Ashford
oneness.title: The near death experience of Jonathan Ashford
oneness.quote: It just consumed everything. It kept growing. Consumed the void. Consumed the being next to me. Consumed me. And when I was fully in it and integrated within it, I recognized that I am the light as well. We're all aspects of that light.

oneness.title: The near-death experience of Heidi Craig
oneness.quote: I instantly knew that we were all connected, that we were all one. Everyone's energy, everyone's vibration, the divine beings and myself, we all had our own rate of vibration and our own color, and they weaved in and out of each other's. It was like a beautiful harmonic progression, and they made these patterns, and it was deeply profound and deeply beautiful.

oneness.title: The near-death experience of Ingrid Honkala
oneness.quote: At that moment is when the sense of self started to dissolve and I started to become one with the whole. I experienced what I say to people is the sense of non-self or the sense of nothingness. There's no sound, there's no color, there's no movement, there's no meaning, there's no description. At this point there was not even thought. It's like all that was gone, just complete a state of oneness. I became existence itself.

oneness.title: The near death experience of Ray Kinman
oneness.quote: I was one of those points of light, and there was an infinite number of them. They were all alive, and we were all connected. There was like one thing, one being. This was God.

oneness.experiencer: The near death experience of Rob Gentile
oneness.title: The near death experience of Rob Gentile
oneness.quote: I knew in that place we're all made of the same stuff, whether it's animate or inanimate objects. We're all connected, we're all one.

oneness.title: The near death experience of Graeme O'Connor
oneness.quote: we were all just connected by this it's like almost like a thread of light or love that everything was connected within this realm

oneness.experiencer: The near death experience of David Ditchfield
oneness.title: The near death experience of David Ditchfield
oneness.quote: I feel like we're all part the universe. When I was in that realm, I felt we are all part of the universe.

oneness.experiencer: The near-death experience of Jane Thompson
oneness.title: The near-death experience of Jane Thompson
oneness.quote: Those were souls that I was seeing, and they were all connected by this very thin, iridescent line, the way that a spider web looks, if you catch it just right in the sunlight. That's what it looks like, which I now realize is oneness and the way that we are all connected.

oneness.experiencer: The near-death experience of Jane Thompson
oneness.title: The near-death experience of Jane Thompson
oneness.quote: As that was happening, I was also getting the sense that this white light that was all around me, that was taking such loving care of me – that I am that white light. I'm not separate from it. I just had the illusion that I had always been separate from it. So while I was a part of it, I really sensed that separation being healed as well.

oneness.experiencer: The near death experience of Dr. Mary Helen Hensley
oneness.title: The near death experience of Dr. Mary Helen Hensley
oneness.quote: Well, that's a little bit what that's like on steroids. You know, it's this feeling of being a complete and utter part of the atmosphere around you, of knowing all of a sudden, 'Oh, this is what eternal feels like. This is what I am part of everything feels like.'

oneness.title: The near death experience of Deborah King
oneness.quote: I remember feeling that I was just suspended in this web, and somehow also I was aware that I was part of it, which was really interesting. I felt separate at first and then very quickly felt that not only was I a part of this web of light and purpose, but I was an important part of that web, and this kind of blew me away.

oneness.title: The near death experience of Deborah King
oneness.quote: I knew I had been there before and I knew that every orb of light was unique. But yet there is absolutely no separation. They are connected to each other in a way that is just magnificent and I'm connected to them.

oneness.experiencer: Doorway to Oneness - With Julien Chameroy (Podcast episode 3)
oneness.title: Doorway to Oneness - With Julien Chameroy (Podcast episode 3)
oneness.quote: You know, you're just one with everyone. So, you know, you you can say you are we, we are together, but at the same times we are the universe experiencing the human aspect of things through us.

oneness.experiencer: Doorway to Oneness - With Julien Chameroy (Podcast episode 3)
oneness.title: Doorway to Oneness - With Julien Chameroy (Podcast episode 3)
oneness.quote: And so, I believe the the oneness experience is going back to what is it to be a universe, basically. And when you go back to that, you can see all the different aspects, all the different human beings, but also plants, animals having an experience all together at the same time. And you experience that.

universal-knowledge.title: Beyond Our Sight (Documentary)
universal-knowledge.quote: I've been in the light and experienced all knowledge

universal-knowledge.title: Renaissance (Documentary)
universal-knowledge.quote: I knew everything. I knew I wasn't going to be able to keep it, but everything came to light. Everything that had been shadowed was now revealed.

universal-knowledge.title: Renaissance (Documentary)
universal-knowledge.quote: I got to feel and understand the cosmos. I got to feel and understand what all of this means. Why we're here, why there's time, why there's struggle. I learned it all.

universal-knowledge.experiencer: The near death experience of Penny Wittbrodt
universal-knowledge.title: The near death experience of Penny Wittbrodt
universal-knowledge.quote: And as it would go through, as the light would touch every little neuron in my brain, I would know things. I would know everything about the world, every question I'd ever had, every question anybody had ever had.

universal-knowledge.title: The near-death experience of Heidi Craig
universal-knowledge.quote: I was shown the past, not just my past, but the past of everyone and everything, and I just had this knowing. I knew and understood why everything happened. I understood that going forward in the future there is a higher purpose and there is a reason for everything, good and bad.

universal-knowledge.title: The near-death experience of Ingrid Honkala
universal-knowledge.quote: You could actually feel and know everything happening with everybody.

universal-knowledge.title: The near death experience of Ray Kinman
universal-knowledge.quote: And I experienced what I could only call a download. It was like billions of questions were answered in just a moment, instantly, and I understood. I understood everything—how the universe works, what our purpose is, all—everything made perfect sense to me. And it was not like I learned anything. It was more like remembering. I already knew it.

universal-knowledge.experiencer: The near death experience of Rob Gentile
universal-knowledge.title: The near death experience of Rob Gentile
universal-knowledge.quote: If I wanted to know the answer to anything, all I had to do was think about it, and it was kind of like it was felt and then absorbed. And with each Insight revealed, I thought, wow, this is how it works. Of course, it's really, really simple. And it was like these mathematical equations were just hanging all around me, and I thought the universe, the way it works, it's so elegant and simple. It's only humans that have made it so difficult to understand. And I knew everything in that place.

universal-knowledge.experiencer: The near-death experience of Jane Thompson
universal-knowledge.title: The near-death experience of Jane Thompson
universal-knowledge.quote: The white light has the answers to all of our questions. Questions that we didn't even know that we had. Once I got into that white light, a lot of the questions that I had didn't even seem to matter anymore. But the answers were still there. Everything just made sense.

universal-knowledge.experiencer: The near death experience of Tammy Lee Anderson
universal-knowledge.title: The near death experience of Tammy Lee Anderson
universal-knowledge.quote: And I realized as I was asking with my words that as soon as I asked with my words then the answer would come into my awareness immediately. And so as I asked the questions faster and faster and faster, soon I realized that we were communicating telepathically without words and all I had to do was think it.

universal-knowledge.experiencer: The near death experience of Tammy Lee Anderson
universal-knowledge.title: The near death experience of Tammy Lee Anderson
universal-knowledge.quote: And so as I asked these questions, I just got this download and I had all this light coming into me. Like they're little darts of light, different colors shooting into my into my body, into my mind, into my heart. And each piece of light, it was information, it was knowing, it was understanding.

timelessness.title: Remembering who we are
timelessness.quote: There's really no sense of time in your dreams. Everything happens at once and you want to go visit Paris, you're instantly in Paris. That's what it's like across the veil.

timelessness.experiencer: How Filmmaker Anthony Chene Explores Consciousness and the Fabric of Reality
timelessness.title: How Filmmaker Anthony Chene Explores Consciousness and the Fabric of Reality
timelessness.quote: And um I think it's uh hard to answer this one because it's we live in space and time here. this life you know we can go to a meeting we have life events we don't know what is ahead of us when we are going to die for most of us we we don't know anything and it's there is time there is space but outside of this reality it's not in space and time like this.

timelessness.title: The near-death experience of Jeff Olsen
timelessness.quote: Now, I have no concept of time in this bubble of light. I don't know how many minutes or hours went by.

timelessness.title: The near death experience of Gabe Poirot
timelessness.quote: During my time with him, it was 18 days that, you know, I was pretty much going My body was pretty much done for on the earth. Yet, for with him, it felt like 2 minutes. Time doesn't operate the same when you're outside of it.

timelessness.experiencer: The near death experience of Jonathan Ashford
timelessness.title: The near death experience of Jonathan Ashford
timelessness.quote: I received information for a period I can only describe as eternity. Even though there was no time there, I knew in that moment that awareness that I was being given information to return with.

timelessness.title: The near-death experience of Heidi Craig
timelessness.quote: Time there does not exist as we know it.

timelessness.title: The near-death experience of Ingrid Honkala
timelessness.quote: For me time and space vanished, and I could be anywhere at any time. There was no limitations of anything.

timelessness.title: The near death experience of Ray Kinman
timelessness.quote: But there was no break in my awareness. I was here, and then I was not. And the most difficult to explain is that time and space disappeared at that point. There was no time. There was only just right now.

timelessness.experiencer: The near death experience of Rob Gentile
timelessness.title: The near death experience of Rob Gentile
timelessness.quote: I found myself inside this Timeless place, kind of like this vacuum of sorts.

timelessness.title: The near death experience of Graeme O'Connor
timelessness.quote: and i'm narrating this in a way that it was in a chronological order but it wasn't everything was just in one go because there's just no time out there and that's why it's this overload of information that you think must take an eternity for the information that i gained and it was literally you know minutes or seconds that i was potentially there for

timelessness.experiencer: The near-death experience of Tricia Barker
timelessness.title: The near-death experience of Tricia Barker
timelessness.quote: outside of body i was just picking up on what it's like to live in a realm without time what it's like to travel at the speed of light what it's like to experience some of the mysteries beyond this life

timelessness.experiencer: The near death experience of David Ditchfield
timelessness.title: The near death experience of David Ditchfield
timelessness.quote: The difference as well is there's no sense of time. Time doesn't exist. It's like there's no past and there's no future. There's only the present, the present moments.

timelessness.experiencer: The near death experience of Scott Drummond
timelessness.title: The near death experience of Scott Drummond
timelessness.quote: but the time that i was gone there was no time that did not mean one thing i can't tell you what how much time i spent watching the video of my myself

timelessness.experiencer: The near death experience of Tammy Lee Anderson

timelessness.quote: When I was in spirit um world and my near-death experience, there was no time, no concept of time. Everything was now. And when we say now, basically that means eternal time. So now is forever. Now is past, present, future. It's all one experience but blending together.

timelessness.experiencer: The near death experience of Nancy Rynes
timelessness.title: The near death experience of Nancy Rynes
timelessness.quote: so i was thinking about that i don't know for how long time was immaterial

timelessness.experiencer: The near death experience of Dr. Mary Helen Hensley
timelessness.title: The near death experience of Dr. Mary Helen Hensley
timelessness.quote: This is when I, I realize it's not about the quantity of time, it's about the quality of life. The ultimate goal for your soul is to come in here and have this immersive, in-depth, rich experience. And so one of the amazing things is, right before I came back into the body, I just had this incredible experience of watching time melt in front of my face and realizing that that's not even real. It's a man-made construct to give us some kind of template through which to work through life.

timelessness.title: The near death experience of Deborah King
timelessness.quote: I had no sense of my past or my future. In fact, there was no sense of time whatsoever. Everything was happening in the now and all at once, which was a little bit mind boggling.

timelessness.experiencer: Doorway to Oneness - With Julien Chameroy (Podcast episode 3)
timelessness.title: Doorway to Oneness - With Julien Chameroy (Podcast episode 3)
timelessness.quote: You know what? When we say there is only now, from my experience, from that one's experience, what I saw was that, you know, time is not a thing. It's not about time. It's more about connections. The connections is what makes the most sense in the universe, more than just time.

welcomed-home.title: Beyond Our Sight (Documentary)
welcomed-home.quote: I've never been so in love or at home or with my family or with it's it's where I'm from and I felt um that this being and I had known each other for I use the term thousands of years or eons we had we'd always known each other

welcomed-home.title: Renaissance (Documentary)
welcomed-home.quote: And yet it seemed like a spiritual home. And in many ways, it was far more real than this world.

welcomed-home.title: The near-death experience of Jeff Olsen
welcomed-home.quote: It's odd what was coming to my mind, Wow, it's good to be home! I was home. I mean, people say heaven or the other side. To me, I was home. It was so familiar. It was so welcoming. I was so joyful to be there.

welcomed-home.title: The near-death experience of Heidi Craig
welcomed-home.quote: When I woke up, I was in heaven. I like to call it home.

welcomed-home.title: The near-death experience of Ingrid Honkala
welcomed-home.quote: For the first time in these three years of my life, I felt that I was home. So it was the sense of like, ah, I'm finally home. Actually this experience was more real than this reality, and I felt that I was being welcomed.

welcomed-home.title: The near-death experiences of Bill McDonald
welcomed-home.quote: I didn't have any questions for anybody there was nothing I didn't feel I knew I'm back I'm back home

welcomed-home.experiencer: The near death experience of Karen Thomas
welcomed-home.title: The near death experience of Karen Thomas
welcomed-home.quote: A lot of us who've had near-death experiences call it—it's like a homesickness, in terms of that is home. What I experienced there is home, and at a level that is beyond what we think of when we think of home here in this life.

welcomed-home.experiencer: The near-death experience of Jane Thompson
welcomed-home.title: The near-death experience of Jane Thompson
welcomed-home.quote: It almost started feeling like my life was becoming a distant memory. It felt so much like home to be in that light that there was no other place I wanted to be at that point. There's no place that feels as good as that light feels.

welcomed-home.experiencer: The near death experience of Tammy Lee Anderson
welcomed-home.title: The near death experience of Tammy Lee Anderson
welcomed-home.quote: This experience is more real than real. It's home, and I remember it like yesterday.

welcomed-home.experiencer: The near death experience of Nancy Rynes
welcomed-home.title: The near death experience of Nancy Rynes
welcomed-home.quote: and the voice said welcome home this is your home you know you're a part of us you're a part of this you know you're a part of me welcome home and i just lost it okay i almost lose it like that every time i talk i tell people about this because it was just so moving and it was so welcoming and i'd never felt in my entire life i'd never felt that welcomed anywhere not as much as i was being welcomed wherever this was that i was in now

welcomed-home.title: The near death experience of Deborah King
welcomed-home.quote: I want to be here. I am home. I know that this is where I came from and now I'm back here and there's nothing that's ever going to get me to leave here.

music-sound.title: Who we are (Documentary)
music-sound.quote: I remember the angelic choirs above that were fueling all this beautiful dancing and merriment served as yet another portal to higher and higher levels.

music-sound.title: Renaissance (Documentary)
music-sound.quote: The grass had a distinct loving music frequency coming from it.

music-sound.experiencer: The near death experience of Gabe Poirot
music-sound.title: The near death experience of Gabe Poirot
music-sound.quote: This city that I was brought to had its own song. And it was full of love everywhere I looked. I would look to the left, to the right, up, down. There was no escape. I I literally felt like a soldier free falling into an ocean of blue liquid love that had no floor to it. And even there was the mountains and the trees and as the wind would blow, it would come alive and the leaves would swing back and forth and they would sing of the love. They would have a hymn of the light.

music-sound.title: The near death experience of Ray Kinman
music-sound.quote: And we were all connected, and we were singing. I mean, it was music, but it makes music as we understand it pretty weak in comparison. This was living and breathing and color and dimension and all-encompassing. It was alive. The music was alive, and we were singing to one another.

music-sound.experiencer: The near death experience of Dr. Mary Helen Hensley
music-sound.title: The near death experience of Dr. Mary Helen Hensley
music-sound.quote: Well, next thing, all of a sudden the sound begins to change. So we go from this kind of low drone sound to this more beautiful orchestral—I call it the Music of the Spheres—this symphony of sounds that don't sound like any kind of music that we have here. So I can't even really adequately describe it to you because I've never been able to hear it here or recreate it here.

music-sound.title: The near death experience of Deborah King
music-sound.quote: I also felt and heard these harmonic vibrations. I would say it was like a most beautiful choir I certainly had ever heard. But not human voices. Just incredibly beautiful harmonic sounds, and also dissonant sounds. But somehow they all worked together in an amazing, purposeful and beautiful way.

pre-birth-home.title: Discovering the emotion code
pre-birth-home.quote: I was 18 years old and sitting meditating quietly one day and all of a sudden that veil of forgetfulness somehow parted to some part of me. I think it was my heart suddenly I was filled with the most absolutely overwhelming feeling of homesickness that I can't even describe. I'd been homesick before but if you took the most homesick you've ever felt in your life and magnified a million times it might come close. It was just otherworldly and it was homesickness to be back in that home where I used to live with my father and with my heavenly parents where we all used to live. This only lasted for about three seconds and then that window closed and it was blocked again to me.

death-premonition.title: A Spiritual Renaissance
death-premonition.quote: for two years i had been dreaming two years before his death i had been dreaming of his death but i looked at it symbolically and sometimes it would be oh no it was my friend's son but i grieved in the dream as though it was my son

death-premonition.title: A Spiritual Renaissance
death-premonition.quote: but my son had also had when he was almost 12 years old he dreamed of his death

death-premonition.title: A Spiritual Renaissance
death-premonition.quote: now my husband had never been concerned with these things before and yet he had a vision of pishti's accident two weeks before it happened and he saw the car on the side of the freeway he saw our son's body superimposed on the car

heavenly-landscape.title: Experiencing Miracles - With Carlos Vivas
heavenly-landscape.quote: So when I look in front of me I couldn't believe what I was I was in heaven. So imagine having like infinitive golf course everything was green beautiful blue skies and then in front of me millions of people dressing white ropes.

heavenly-landscape.experiencer: The near death experience of Karen Thomas
heavenly-landscape.title: The near death experience of Karen Thomas
heavenly-landscape.quote: And as we came up out of this area, up over the slope, the whole landscape changed. And suddenly it was a totally green, lush, gorgeous-looking area, grass and bright flowers, all kinds of colors that I had never seen before, trees with beautiful lush leaves. It was mesmerizing, and I noticed that this immense light that I had come into was actually within every living thing that I was looking at—inside the flowers, inside the grass, inside the trees and leaves—and emanating out.

heavenly-landscape.experiencer: The near death experience of Scott Drummond
heavenly-landscape.title: The near death experience of Scott Drummond
heavenly-landscape.quote: what happened next was almost like a twinkling of an eye and i was standing in an open field it was the most beautiful surrounding that i could have ever been in and i'll tell you why because where i was standing was in grass and grass was up to about my waist and that grass was not blowing like the wind it was flowing and i remember so vividly touching the tops of that grass and filling something so special

return-mission.title: Experiencing Miracles - With Carlos Vivas
return-mission.quote: I said like no Carlos you make a promise to me now you need to fulfill that promise. Okay Carlos go back and tell everyone what happened here.

return-mission.experiencer: The near death experience of Gabe Poirot
return-mission.title: The near death experience of Gabe Poirot
return-mission.quote: And so, before he sent me back, he told me, he said, "Gabriel, tell them who I really am."

life-purpose-message.experiencer: Straight to Heaven : A Message from the Angels
life-purpose-message.title: Straight to Heaven : A Message from the Angels
life-purpose-message.quote: And then God saying to me, "Lorna, you have to go back. You have an awful lot to do. You're not to be hiding from me."

life-purpose-message.experiencer: The nature of reality - With Darius J. Wright
life-purpose-message.title: The nature of reality - With Darius J. Wright
life-purpose-message.quote: I said okay so what could I do what is the purpose of this what what could I actually do here right now and they said oh do what's considered the great work which is waking people up to the other side because when they wake up to the Eternal aspect of who and what they really are they wake up to everything

life-purpose-message.title: The near-death experiences of Bill McDonald
life-purpose-message.quote: but now want you to suffer real pain so you could tell other people how to handle their real physical pain and behind him in the sky is see an ocean of faces that have been unfolding and rolling out to me ever since and he said these faces of people that need to hear something you need to say read something you've written maybe it's just somebody you're gonna give a smile to a hug pat on the back maybe it's just your presence in their life will help them in some way some large some small

life-purpose-message.title: The near death experience of Ray Kinman
life-purpose-message.quote: Then I was reassured—we reassured me—that it's okay. You can come back any time you want, any time, once you fulfilled your purpose, which I got. I got it.

life-purpose-message.experiencer: The near death experience of Rob Gentile
life-purpose-message.title: The near death experience of Rob Gentile
life-purpose-message.quote: I had asked the question, you know, why am I here? And there was that voice again. I heard one word: testify.

life-purpose-message.experiencer: The near-death experience of Tricia Barker
life-purpose-message.title: The near-death experience of Tricia Barker
life-purpose-message.quote: and then suddenly i saw like a place on earth and there was this river i saw it as a metaphor this was the river of life and i was also given a message that i was gonna teach and that mission has been incredibly powerful

life-purpose-message.title: The near death experience of Deborah King
life-purpose-message.quote: I'm here to give you a message: There really aren’t any accidents in life. When we had that experience, when you were a young nurse, that was not an accident. One of the important missions of your life is you really need to share that. You've kind of kept that experience to yourself. You didn't share it with anybody, but now you have to do that. Now is the time that can help a lot of people.

tunnel.title: Beyond Our Sight (Documentary)
tunnel.quote: my spirit and soul immediately left my body in the car and went through the tunnel we hear people talk about quickly all the way through to the other end and out to the other end into Pure White Light

tunnel.experiencer: The near death experience of Malcolm Nair
tunnel.title: The near death experience of Malcolm Nair
tunnel.quote: I ended up leaving my body and going further and further and further away. I was almost not in control I didn't know what was going on but I knew I had to do this. My body was being pulled and I was able to see everything. I was able to see the hospital, see the land and I left this atmosphere into space and entered the tunnel and I was warped right through.

tunnel.title: The near death experience of Pegi Robinson
tunnel.quote: Suddenly, I am shot like a rocket through space. I'm in this tight like a rope or a tunnel and I'm shot straight up and it's like a roller coaster. It's like bumpy and it's loud and kind of see through walls cuz I could kind of see like space was out there like a whizzing.

tunnel.title: The near-death experience of Nadia McCaffrey
tunnel.quote: I was attracted to the light and I floated back again to this spot where I couldn't see the light but I was very strongly swallowed in that space practically swallowed and sped out I found out later that it's the tunnel but it's called the tunnel today and it just dropped me on the other side where the light was

tunnel.experiencer: The near death experience of Karen Thomas
tunnel.title: The near death experience of Karen Thomas
tunnel.quote: I reached the water's edge, and a dark tunnel, cave-like opening opened up, and I was drawn into it. And once I was inside, I began moving extremely fast and began to notice that the only light I could see—it was all dark around me—was a pinprick of light way off in the distance. And the faster I went, the larger the light was becoming until I finally burst into the light itself.

tunnel.title: The near-death experience of Peter Anthony
tunnel.quote: I began to see the first tunnel while I was on the operating table, and I could see this tunnel spinning, rotating. I call it the bullseye.

tunnel.experiencer: The near-death experience of Jane Thompson
tunnel.title: The near-death experience of Jane Thompson
tunnel.quote: Then I immediately felt myself go into the tunnel. It was very black, very dark in the tunnel. I wasn't scared at all. I was moving very fast. It was exciting and it felt exhilarating. The tunnel ride was very quick and I popped right out of the tunnel and I was immediately in the white light.

tunnel.experiencer: The near death experience of Tammy Lee Anderson
tunnel.title: The near death experience of Tammy Lee Anderson
tunnel.quote: And the first thing I experienced was going into the tunnel that everybody talks about, the light. There was many, many souls. And I could see outlines of figures going towards the light.

life-purpose.title: Beyond Our Sight (Documentary)
life-purpose.quote: Lewis you were called here to have this conversation and to be sent back because you are not doing your work

life-purpose.title: Beyond Our Sight (Documentary)
life-purpose.quote: I was told immediately no it's not my work you need to do Lewis it's your work I then asked well what is my work

life-purpose.title: Who we are (Documentary)
life-purpose.quote: I started to understand that I had a bigger purpose to fulfill, something much bigger. And I didn’t know what it was, I had no idea what it was. But I was like I had the understanding that all I have to do is to be myself and live my life fearlessly... and my purpose would unfold before me.

life-purpose.experiencer: The near-death experience of Chris Batts
life-purpose.title: The near-death experience of Chris Batts
life-purpose.quote: And he says: You have so much to do for so many people.

life-purpose.title: The near-death experience of Barbara Bartolome
life-purpose.quote: On top of that, I also knew up there on the ceiling what my plan was for my life, what my purpose was. And I said to the being, I haven't completed my my purpose and I really want to go back into my life to be able to do that to do what I had planned to do.

shown-the-future.title: Beyond Our Sight (Documentary)
shown-the-future.quote: they opened the door to the classroom and they said you can look at this you know this is a classroom people are learning things and they were at a keyboard they were actually and you have to realize this is like 1951 cuz I was born in 1945 there were no such things as computers especially personal computers they were big huge room siiz things then those days and nobody uh nobody had ever heard of such a thing you know there were like there were typewriters of course but these were not keyboards like that they had little squares and they also lit up I could see the light underneath them like some were blue and some were red and some were green and I remember that the man told me he said you will see these later in your life

shown-the-future.experiencer: Messages from the other side - With Pontea Dianati
shown-the-future.title: Messages from the other side - With Pontea Dianati
shown-the-future.quote: And I kind of saw an image of like my family. I saw image of my animals. and I saw humanity and I saw all the bad things that was basically going to happen in the world which wasn't a surprise to me cuz I kind of already had seen that vision a few years before but that voice showed that to me

shown-the-future.title: The near-death experiences of Bill McDonald
shown-the-future.quote: all of a sudden this vision starts unfolding this panorama of the next 50 years of my life including the John F Kennedy assassination including my wife who I met and my children migrated in and jobs I'd have the Vietnam War which I didn't realize was the Vietnam War I just a war with helicopters in it I saw all these things for about fifty years of my life transpiring

shown-the-future.title: The near-death experience of Peter Anthony
shown-the-future.quote: I also got a chance to see my life ahead. I saw myself speaking to scores of people at lectures. I saw myself writing books. I saw myself traveling around the world talking about my near-death experience. I also saw my two-year recovery, and I knew the challenges ahead, the psychiatrist, and I also saw my attempted suicide. All these things I saw ahead.

shown-the-future.experiencer: The near death experience of Vinney Tolman (Podcast episode 2)
shown-the-future.title: The near death experience of Vinney Tolman (Podcast episode 2)
shown-the-future.quote: So, in you know, back in 2003, when they wanted to put me back in my body, they had to find my time. They had to bring me to my time. And in doing that, I could easily see what was coming in the near future. And, you know, some of it was beautiful. Some of it was a little scary. But, I could see that all of it that happens, it's for our betterment. It actually makes us better as beings.

shown-the-future.experiencer: The near death experience of Vinney Tolman (Podcast episode 2)
shown-the-future.title: The near death experience of Vinney Tolman (Podcast episode 2)
shown-the-future.quote: You know, one of the things I saw when I died and was coming back is I saw in the future there's a lot of these cities of light. They're like smaller communities. They don't get very big. And they start out as these little communities and they grow, but they're communities based on supporting each other, uh showing up for each other, healing each other, teaching each other, and and like ministering to each other.

360-degree-vision.title: Who we are (Documentary)
360-degree-vision.quote: It was very different from having physical eyes. It was more like I had 360 degree peripheral vision. I could be aware of things that would happen behind, on the sides, above, below, everywhere... and beyond the walls.

rapid-healing.title: Who we are (Documentary)
rapid-healing.quote: And then, what started to happen is over the next few days: the tumours just continued to shrink. The doctors just could not understand it. I had to start getting a little bit stronger and start getting out of bed and within 3 and a half weeks they could find no trace of the cancer anymore. And within 5 weeks they let me go home to live my life cancer-free.

dark-void.title: Renaissance (Documentary)
dark-void.quote: This is when I went to essentially the darkest place I've ever gone in my life.

dark-void.title: Renaissance (Documentary)
dark-void.quote: I was in this really dark place, like the darkest place you've ever seen. I thought, wo, what has happened, you know, where am I? I couldn't see anything around me.

shown-future.title: Renaissance (Documentary)
shown-future.quote: So, this kind of movie thing opens back up and I can see my oldest son, he's looking down on a soccer field and I'm sitting next to him and my grandson, who was two at the time, but in this image, he's five, he's running up and down the field.

shown-future.title: Renaissance (Documentary)
shown-future.quote: One of the gifts they showed me is they allowed me to see into our future, what our future looks like as humanity on on this earth. And they showed me a great transition, a great separation between our old self and our new self.

shown-future.title: The nature of our soul
shown-future.quote: I have come out of my body and I've seen future events. I've seen potentialities of things to occur. Some of them don't, some of them do.

shown-future.title: The nature of our soul
shown-future.quote: And from 16 years old, I was shown everything becomes free and there's a massive celebration.

tunnel-of-light.experiencer: How Filmmaker Anthony Chene Explores Consciousness and the Fabric of Reality
tunnel-of-light.title: How Filmmaker Anthony Chene Explores Consciousness and the Fabric of Reality
tunnel-of-light.quote: Also, many NDE accounts they talk about the tunnel of light. It's hard for them to describe that because it's beyond words what they experience. The words we use, it's for this reality. So, they try to describe it, but it's very hard for them. A tunnel of light with a white light at the end of it, a loving light. And I think basically it's like the switch, the passing between dimensions, you know, between realms.

tunnel-of-light.experiencer: The near death experience of David Ditchfield
tunnel-of-light.title: The near death experience of David Ditchfield
tunnel-of-light.quote: And what I saw just behind the being at my feet was a huge tunnel of white light that was coming closer and closer to me. It was circling with flames, or flames that were circling all around in this edge of this huge tunnel of white light. Again it was the same whiteness that was in these grids, but it was a lot more powerful and a lot more intense.

tunnel-of-light.title: The near death experience of Bruce Van Natta
tunnel-of-light.quote: But this time, a tunnel opened up. Like some people have a near-death experience or out of body experience. They see a tunnel with a light on the end of it. And it was going up like at a 45 degree angle. It was like a million miles long. And there's a bright light on the end of the tunnel. And I knew that I knew that I knew that I knew heaven was on the end of that tunnel. And I started going towards the light really fast.

no-judgment.title: The near-death experience of Jeff Olsen
no-judgment.quote: I was told that I could be angry at God my whole life and think that he took my family away or that, you know, somehow life was not fair and that was okay. There was no judgment whatsoever. I could do that.

void.experiencer: The near death experience of Penny Wittbrodt
void.title: The near death experience of Penny Wittbrodt
void.quote: And so, when I'm aware again, I'm in this dark place and it's really dark. You can't see your hand in front of your face, but it's weird because I have this I still have this visual image of me in that space. But I couldn't see what was around me. I knew I wasn't standing on anything. I wasn't lying down. I wasn't sitting. Something was kind of suspending me.

void.experiencer: The near death experience of Penny Wittbrodt
void.title: The near death experience of Penny Wittbrodt
void.quote: That was the dark place. That was the void. I made that. I had walled myself off from all these people and created this spiritually dark place and spent what felt like 10 years in our time in that dark place.

void.title: The near death experience of Ray Kinman
void.quote: There was no past, and also there was no time, but there was no space either. And I can only describe this first part as a void. There was no light. There was no dark. There was no gravity. There was no sensations. It was just like nothing.

body-cord.experiencer: The near death experience of Penny Wittbrodt
body-cord.title: The near death experience of Penny Wittbrodt
body-cord.quote: She said, "You're kind of in between. You've got the view that's, you know, sick in the hospital and then the spirit side of you that's here, and there's a cord that's attaching you to your body. But if you decide to stay, the cord will be broken and you'll stay. And if you decide to go back, the cord will pull you back."

future-vision.experiencer: The near death experience of Penny Wittbrodt
future-vision.title: The near death experience of Penny Wittbrodt
future-vision.quote: And he's like, "Oh my goodness, you've completely misunderstood me. Let me show you." And so this scene unfolds and it's me in the future.

future-vision.title: The near death experience of Pegi Robinson
future-vision.quote: And I had a vision of the future. I could see my family and our white station wagon, my parents, the four kids going in and out of there, and they would always say, "That's where Peg is."

future-vision.title: The near death experience of Pegi Robinson
future-vision.quote: And we dropped down immediately to Earth. And we're above the trailer. It's at night time. There's my three boys in the bedroom. And they're discussing the fact that mom has died. So this is in the future. I'm getting to see how my boys would be.

future-vision.title: The near-death experience of Nadia McCaffrey
future-vision.quote: there was a voice again that asked me do you want to come home and at the same time there was a flashing it show me the past the present and to future but that was not me it was not my life it was the planet was the earth so of course I recognize the past I recognized the present and to future we could have have a much different and easier future on one side and the other one was where we are now

future-vision.experiencer: The near death experience of Karen Thomas
future-vision.title: The near death experience of Karen Thomas
future-vision.quote: And they then said, “You can go back to your life or you can stay here, but before you decide, we want to show you things that will happen if you go back to your life, or some things that may happen or may not, depending on another person's free will choices that could alter what we're going to show you here, because everyone has free will.”

heavenly-city.experiencer: The near death experience of Gabe Poirot
heavenly-city.title: The near death experience of Gabe Poirot
heavenly-city.quote: I describe it as a city, but it wasn't even just an urban location. The city has it had its own breath. This city that I was brought to had its own song.

heavenly-city.experiencer: The near death experience of Gabe Poirot
heavenly-city.title: The near death experience of Gabe Poirot
heavenly-city.quote: There was these golden streets. There was these gemstones. There was these these monuments.

past-lives.experiencer: The near death experience of Jonathan Ashford
past-lives.title: The near death experience of Jonathan Ashford
past-lives.quote: And it wasn't until that being left the rock and walked down to meet me, standing amongst this waving grass, that he stood in front of me and showed me several different existences, different identities that I had been a part of over time until he landed on the identity of me, the person who had just passed.

past-lives.title: The near-death experience of Heidi Craig
past-lives.quote: And I also was shown that we've all done bad things. We've all had past lives where we have not been so kind and compassionate and caring. I was shown that, so I know in a past life that maybe I was a murderer, or maybe I was a thief, or maybe I did something bad, but I've evolved.

information-download.experiencer: The near death experience of Jonathan Ashford
information-download.title: The near death experience of Jonathan Ashford
information-download.quote: So once I became formless and the landscape became formless, I received information for a period I can only describe as eternity. Even though there was no time there, I knew in that moment that awareness that I was being given information to return with. It wasn't to return to talk about my near-death experience so much, although I'm happy to, but it was to share information. So, while I was in that formless place, I call it the void. It's alive, but it's also formless in a way where you understand all things that take form come from this place. And I was given information and revelations and teachings and things that went on for what seemed like forever. I was given things about time and reality and perception, about why things happen here, what we experience, what you really are versus what you think you are. truth, what it means, how we are truth itself without realizing it.

hellish-realm.experiencer: The near death experience of John Paul Martinez
hellish-realm.title: The near death experience of John Paul Martinez
hellish-realm.quote: Now, the scriptures talk about a place called the outer darkness. I'm there and and it seemed like there was stages of darkness. At least that's what I saw. And like this fear came over me. This crazy fear came over me. It was almost like a quenching fear. You know, I've never experienced anything like this before.

hellish-realm.experiencer: The near death experience of John Paul Martinez
hellish-realm.title: The near death experience of John Paul Martinez
hellish-realm.quote: At first, I thought it was people laughing and rejoicing, but it was actually people screaming for help. And I remember I heard this man, but he was like in the deeper darkness. And I remember him saying, "Help me. Help me. Help me."

panoramic-vision.title: The near death experience of Pegi Robinson
panoramic-vision.quote: And I thought, "Well, there's something different about my vision now. I can see below the water and above the water at the same time." Like if you were looking over at a fish tank, you could see above and below. It was like I was an outsider looking at both.

bodyless-consciousness.title: The near-death experience of Heidi Craig
bodyless-consciousness.quote: I was me. I felt me. I felt what I looked like. It didn't change, but I didn't have a body. I was my vibration, the energy.

soul-contract.title: The near-death experience of Heidi Craig
soul-contract.quote: What I was shown when I was home and having my experience is there is a purpose, there is a reason for everything, and we have a soul contract, and we come into this life with lessons that we are to learn.

thought-travel.title: The near-death experience of Ingrid Honkala
thought-travel.quote: I got distracted by the realization that wherever I put my mind I could go. So it's like, whoa, if I put my mind at the end of the street, I will be there. If I would just see an animal, whatever it was, I will be there.

profound-silence.title: The near-death experience of Ingrid Honkala
profound-silence.quote: I also experienced this state of absolute silence. So it was what I call this silence behind the silence.

purpose-message.title: The near-death experience of Nadia McCaffrey
purpose-message.quote: she said that she had a message for me the message number one was that I was not going to die I was going to heal and live quite a long time but I had a lot of things to do and basically what I had to remember was that I was on this Earth to help people

360-degree-perception.title: The near death experience of Graeme O'Connor
360-degree-perception.quote: if i didn't have 360 degree perception i would have just assumed that i was against one of these huge columns that i was in between but there was nothing behind me

expanded-consciousness.title: The near death experience of Graeme O'Connor
expanded-consciousness.quote: i was aware that my consciousness would not get into that body form my consciousness was immense it was huge at this time and it was just no way it was going to get back into this tiny body

point-of-no-return.experiencer: The near-death experience of Chris Batts
point-of-no-return.title: The near-death experience of Chris Batts
point-of-no-return.quote: Next thing, you know, I'm up in the air. I see this big cloud that was a in a circle shape. If I were to cross that I would probably have went to like heaven or something like that. Or paradise, whatever you may call it.

healing-energy.experiencer: The near-death experience of Tricia Barker
healing-energy.title: The near-death experience of Tricia Barker
healing-energy.quote: and then they almost playfully said watch this and they sent this blast of energy through the back of the surgeons into their hands and it lit up my whole body so i knew that they were participating in this healing

verified-observation.experiencer: The near-death experience of Tricia Barker
verified-observation.title: The near-death experience of Tricia Barker
verified-observation.quote: i saw my stepdad getting a candy bar out of a vending machine and i thought that's funny that he eats candy bars because he's always bragging about what a vegan he is in a health nut and you know all these things and later i asked my mom if she saw him get a candy bar and she said that at that moment her and my dad were on their knees praying and they were certain that i died in surgery and then he came back in with this candy bar offered them some of the candy and made a joke and i was like well i was dead at that moment mom that's the moment that you felt i was dead and i truly was

verified-observation.title: The near-death experience of Barbara Bartolome
verified-observation.quote: And she's the person who brought in the oxygen cart and connected it up to my face. And that man brought in the heart monitor and I actually watched it flatlining. Then you said this to him and he said that to you and I explained the conversation that the two doctors had been having just before they did the precordial thump. You said, "Stand clear." You stepped two steps forward and you struck me in my chest, but it didn't work the first time. And the second time that you struck me, then I came back.

border-point-of-no-return.experiencer: The near-death experience of Tricia Barker
border-point-of-no-return.title: The near-death experience of Tricia Barker
border-point-of-no-return.quote: but at some point i was stopped it was like there was a barrier

spiritual-healing.experiencer: The near death experience of David Ditchfield
spiritual-healing.title: The near death experience of David Ditchfield
spiritual-healing.quote: They were healing my body, but not only my body and the physical wounds I had just been through, but I felt like my soul was being healed as well. I felt like all the years of baggage that I've been carrying with me that I talked about earlier, or the feelings of guilt and shame and all those things were just been slowly peeled off one by one. They were just getting down to the pure essence of my soul and healing that.

boundary-point.experiencer: The near death experience of Karen Thomas
boundary-point.title: The near death experience of Karen Thomas
boundary-point.quote: And I wanted to go across this water, this beautiful bright glistening water, to where they were, but my guide said, “No, you can't go now. We have somewhere else we have to go first.”

pre-birth-planning.experiencer: The near death experience of Karen Thomas
pre-birth-planning.title: The near death experience of Karen Thomas
pre-birth-planning.quote: And I got the feeling that I should know who these beings were. I felt as though they had helped me plan my life before I was ever born. They knew all of what I had hoped to accomplish in my life.

veridical-observation.experiencer: The near death experience of Karen Thomas
veridical-observation.title: The near death experience of Karen Thomas
veridical-observation.quote: So at the appointment, I told him what I had seen when I had my experience and told him about how he was dressed and what he looked like and what happened, and asked him, “Is that what happened?” And he responded back to me, “How could you know that?” and told me that he had been in his office seeing patients and had been paged to the hospital to try to save someone who had had a major artery cut and was bleeding, had bled out on the operating room table, and that yes, that was how he was dressed, yes, that was why I had seen him dressed like he was.

unfinished-purpose.experiencer: The near death experience of Scott Drummond
unfinished-purpose.title: The near death experience of Scott Drummond
unfinished-purpose.quote: that arm pulled back and said it is not yet your time you have more things yet to do and i'll never forget that because it was word for word it is not yet your time you have more things yet to do

pre-birth-plan.experiencer: The near death experience of Nancy Rynes
pre-birth-plan.title: The near death experience of Nancy Rynes
pre-birth-plan.quote: so kind of in the air in front of me it's very weird how how this this happened but in the air in front of me she showed me the time before i was born when i was agreeing to some of the things that i wanted to do and experience while i was in this life of nancy

future-predictions.experiencer: The near death experience of Nancy Rynes
future-predictions.title: The near death experience of Nancy Rynes
future-predictions.quote: and before i was sent back here my teacher gave me some predictions about the future i don't know exactly why she did this i think it was because she knew i was so skeptical and that i would need little signposts along the way once i came back to know that my experience was real so she told me about certain things in my own life basically minor stuff like you know breaking up of a relationship i was in meeting certain people very specific people um not necessarily like romance type stuff but friends and and people that i would meet along my journey and then she gave me some some bigger predictions kind of for the nation and the world that were again those signposts that i would know that all of this was real

mission-to-share.experiencer: The near death experience of Nancy Rynes
mission-to-share.title: The near death experience of Nancy Rynes
mission-to-share.quote: the other thing at this point that she mentioned once she did her healing on my my body she said you know you might want to share this information with other people other people could could potentially benefit from what we're teaching you today and i thought at first well i you know i can do that i can tell my friends and family about it and she said well you might want to you know think about different ways that you can put it out there to a wider audience because other people might want to hear about it

self-judgment.experiencer: The near death experience of Dr. Mary Helen Hensley
self-judgment.title: The near death experience of Dr. Mary Helen Hensley
self-judgment.quote: I was told in the Southern Baptist Church that there was going to be a judgment, and guess what, guys? Nobody was judging me but me. I was critiquing my performance. I didn't realize this tiny little thing that I had done had made such a huge impact over here, where I was thinking I was so awesome because I had done this and it really had very little impact on something. I was watching and critiquing my own performance, but with such love, as if you're watching someone who's not you, because it's actually only a piece of you.

otherworldly-field.title: The near death experience of Landon Dennis
otherworldly-field.quote: I was just all of a sudden standing in this huge, beautiful grass field. a beautiful green. And at first it was just me standing there, but what was crazy is when I looked down at the grass, it I wish I could describe the color and and the feelings I got just from this grass with with words. But words are so inadequate. The way I've come to think of it is like spiritual experiences are almost indescribable in human words, but I do the best I can. And that grass loved me. It was amazing sensation.

uncrossable-boundary.title: The near death experience of Landon Dennis
uncrossable-boundary.quote: And she just started communicating so many just amazing things with me and was telling me a little bit about why I couldn't go back behind that hill. But the gratitude that I felt that I even got to experience my grandma or my grandpa and niece was it made it okay that I couldn't go back behind that hill because I still got to experience that.

possible-futures.title: The near death experience of Landon Dennis
